description: Longest simulated CI shard in seconds for scripts/ci-test-shard.ts, scored against held-out per-file timings. CI runs 2 shards per OS.
notes: The assignment function sees only paths and byte sizes, as in CI. Any timing estimates must come from a committed file in the mutable set derived from CI run history, never from the held-out fixture. Windows flake isolation is out of scope for this measurement.
